    • updateDiagnostics

      public void updateDiagnostics(PlanetPreset planet, EcologyPreset eco, String demoSource, javafx.scene.image.Image elevImg, javafx.scene.image.Image densityImg, int dimsCount, Map<Integer, javafx.scene.image.Image> customTensorImages, IntFunction<String> tensorTitleSupplier, long startYear, long initPop, List<String> validationErrors, EngineConflictReport jitReport)
      Updates real-time diagnostic items and warnings based on current scenario parameters.
      Parameters:
      planet - active planet preset
      eco - active ecology preset
      demoSource - selected demographic source identifier
      elevImg - elevation raster image
      densityImg - custom population density image
      dimsCount - cultural vector dimension count
      customTensorImages - custom tensor raster images map
      tensorTitleSupplier - title supplier per tensor index
      startYear - starting epoch year
      initPop - initial total population count
      validationErrors - current parameter validation errors
      jitReport - JIT conflict report
